ucs.title: [LLM] RansomHub TDSSKiller abuse to neuter EDR via signed Kaspersky rootkit utility
ucs.description: Detects RansomHub affiliates running Kaspersky's legitimately signed TDSSKiller (or a renamed copy) with the -dcsvc/-dcexc/-tdlfs flags to disable EDR services before deploying ransomware. CISA AA24-242A and Sophos X-Ops documented this as a signature RansomHub pre-impact move; the binary's valid Kaspersky signature lets it sail past application-control and signed-binary heuristics.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where (Processes.process_name="tdsskiller.exe" OR Processes.original_file_name="TDSSKiller.exe" OR Processes.process="*TDSSKiller*") (Processes.process="*-dcsvc*" OR Processes.process="*-dcexc*" OR Processes.process="*-tdlfs*" OR Processes.process="*-silent*") by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.parent_process_name Processes.process_name Processes.process Processes.process_hash | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | where NOT match(user, "(?i).*\$$") | where NOT match(parent_process_name, "(?i)^(ksde|avp|kavfs|kaspersky)\.exe$") | convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime) | table firstTime, lastTime, dest, user, parent_process_name, process_name, process, process_hash
ucs.kql:
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(7d)
| where (FileName =~ "tdsskiller.exe"
      or ProcessVersionInfoOriginalFileName =~ "TDSSKiller.exe"
      or ProcessVersionInfoFileDescription has "TDSS"
      or ProcessCommandLine has "TDSSKiller")
| where ProcessCommandLine has_any ("-dcsvc", "-dcexc", "-tdlfs", "-silent", "-accepteula")
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| where InitiatingProcessFileName !in~ ("ksde.exe","avp.exe","kavfs.exe","kavfswp.exe")
| extend RenamedOrRelocated = iff(FileName !~ "tdsskiller.exe" or FolderPath !startswith @"C:\Program Files", "yes", "no")
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FileName, FolderPath, ProcessCommandLine,
          ProcessVersionInfoCompanyName, ProcessVersionInfoOriginalFileName,
          InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
          ParentProcess = InitiatingProcessParentFileName, RenamedOrRelocated, SHA256
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| where EventID == 4688
| where (NewProcessName endswith @"\tdsskiller.exe"
      or CommandLine has "TDSSKiller")
| where CommandLine has_any ("-dcsvc", "-dcexc", "-tdlfs", "-silent")
| where SubjectUserName !endswith "$"
| where ParentProcessName !endswith @"\ksde.exe"
     and ParentProcessName !endswith @"\avp.exe"
     and ParentProcessName !endswith @"\kavfs.exe"
| extend RenamedOrRelocated = iff(NewProcessName !endswith @"\Program Files\Kaspersky Lab\TDSSKiller\tdsskiller.exe", "yes", "no")
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, SubjectUserName, NewProcessName, CommandLine, ParentProcessName, RenamedOrRelocated
| order by TimeGenerated desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: RansomHub TDSSKiller Abuse for EDR Service Disable
id: 2a3f4b1c-7d8e-49a0-b612-rh001tdsskill
status: experimental
description: Detects abuse of Kaspersky's TDSSKiller signed utility with service-disable flags - a CISA-documented RansomHub pre-encryption EDR tampering technique.
references:
  - https://www.cisa.gov/news-events/cybersecurity-advisories/aa24-242a
  - https://news.sophos.com/en-us/2024/08/14/remote-encryption-ransomhub-tdsskiller/
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/06/19
tags:
  - attack.defense_evasion
  - attack.t1562.001
  - attack.t1218
  - threat.ransomhub
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_image:
    - Image|endswith: '\tdsskiller.exe'
    - OriginalFileName: 'TDSSKiller.exe'
    - CommandLine|contains: 'TDSSKiller'
  selection_flags:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - '-dcsvc '
      - '-dcexc '
      - '-tdlfs'
      - '-silent'
  filter_kav_parent:
    ParentImage|endswith:
      - '\ksde.exe'
      - '\avp.exe'
      - '\kavfs.exe'
  condition: (1 of selection_image) and selection_flags and not filter_kav_parent
falsepositives:
  - Sanctioned Kaspersky technician troubleshooting rootkits (must be ticketed; rare)
level: high
ucs.datadog_query: source:(windows.sysmon OR windows.security) (@EventID:(1 OR 4688)) (@Image:(*\tdsskiller.exe OR *\TDSSKiller.exe OR *\TDSSKILLER.EXE) OR @CommandLine:(*TDSSKiller* OR *tdsskiller*)) AND @CommandLine:(*-dcsvc* OR *-dcexc* OR *-tdlfs* OR *-silent*) -@User:*$
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2
| (ImageFileName=/\\tdsskiller\.exe$/i OR CommandLine=/TDSSKiller/i)
| CommandLine=/(-dcsvc|-dcexc|-tdlfs|-silent)/i
| NOT UserName=/\$$/
| NOT ParentBaseFileName=/(ksde|avp|kavfs|kavfswp)\.exe$/i
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName, ImageFileName, CommandLine, SHA256HashData], function=count())
| sort(field=_count, order=desc)
ucs.rationale: TDSSKiller with -dcsvc/-dcexc to disable named services is overwhelmingly RansomHub tradecraft post-2024. Legit Kaspersky usage is rare, only ever launched from %ProgramFiles%\Kaspersky Lab\, never run by interactive accounts at scale, and never paired with rapid follow-on impact prep. The signed-binary aspect (T1553.002) means traditional code-trust EDRs miss it - this hunt anchors on the flag co

ucs.title: [LLM] RansomHub RMM stack deployment (Atera/Splashtop/AnyDesk) followed by shadow-copy and recovery destruction
ucs.description: Catches the RansomHub affiliate playbook of silently MSI-installing remote-management software (Atera, Splashtop, AnyDesk, ScreenConnect) as a redundant access channel, then within 24h running the canonical vssadmin/bcdedit/wbadmin recovery-destruction sequence on the same host. The pairing is far more specific than either signal alone: legit IT deploys RMM without follow-on shadow deletion, and shadow deletion without prior RMM deploy is a different actor profile.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true min(_time) as RMMTime values(Processes.process) as RMMCmd values(Processes.user) as RMMUser from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where ((Processes.process_name=msiexec.exe (Processes.process="*AteraAgent*" OR Processes.process="*Splashtop*" OR Processes.process="*AnyDesk*" OR Processes.process="*ScreenConnect*" OR Processes.process="*ConnectWiseControl*") (Processes.process="*/quiet*" OR Processes.process="*/qn*")) OR Processes.process_name IN (AteraAgent.exe, SplashtopStreamer.exe, AnyDesk.exe, ScreenConnect.ClientService.exe)) by Processes.dest | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | join type=inner dest [| tstats summariesonly=true min(_time) as ImpactTime values(Processes.process) as ImpactCmd values(Processes.process_name) as ImpactBin from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where (Processes.process_name=vssadmin.exe Processes.process="*delete shadows*") OR (Processes.process_name=wmic.exe Processes.process="*shadowcopy*" Processes.process="*delete*") OR (Processes.process_name=bcdedit.exe (Processes.process="*recoveryenabled No*" OR Processes.process="*bootstatuspolicy ignoreallfailures*")) OR (Processes.process_name=wbadmin.exe Processes.process="*delete*catalog*") by Processes.dest | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)`] | where ImpactTime > RMMTime AND ImpactTime < (RMMTime + 86400) | eval DelayHours = round((ImpactTime - RMMTime)/3600, 2) | convert ctime(RMMTime) ctime(ImpactTime) | table RMMTime, ImpactTime, DelayHours, dest, RMMUser, RMMCmd, ImpactBin, ImpactCmd
ucs.kql:
let LookbackDays = 7d;
let WindowSec = 86400;
let RMM = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where (FileName =~ "msiexec.exe"
             and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("AteraAgent","Splashtop","AnyDesk","ScreenConnect","ConnectWiseControl")
             and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("/quiet","/qn"," /q "))
          or FileName in~ ("AteraAgent.exe","SplashtopStreamer.exe","AnyDesk.exe","ConnectWiseControl.ClientService.exe")
    | where AccountName !endswith "$"
    | where InitiatingProcessFileName !in~ ("ccmexec.exe","intunemanagementextension.exe","sccmclient.exe","chocolatey.exe","choco.exe")
    | project RMMTime = Timestamp, DeviceName, RMMUser = AccountName,
              RMMCmd = ProcessCommandLine, RMMBin = FileName,
              RMMParent = InitiatingProcessFileName;
let Impact = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where (FileName =~ "vssadmin.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("delete shadows","resize shadowstorage"))
         or (FileName =~ "wmic.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has "shadowcopy" and ProcessCommandLine has "delete")
         or (FileName =~ "bcdedit.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("recoveryenabled no","bootstatuspolicy ignoreallfailures"))
         or (FileName =~ "wbadmin.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has "delete" and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("catalog","backup","systemstatebackup"))
    | project ImpactTime = Timestamp, DeviceName, ImpactCmd = ProcessCommandLine, ImpactBin = FileName;
RMM
| join kind=inner Impact on DeviceName
| where ImpactTime between (RMMTime .. RMMTime + WindowSec * 1s)
| project RMMTime, ImpactTime,
          DelayHours = datetime_diff('hour', ImpactTime, RMMTime),
          DeviceName, RMMUser, RMMParent, RMMBin, RMMCmd, ImpactBin, ImpactCmd
| summarize arg_min(RMMTime, *) by DeviceName
| order by ImpactTime desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let LookbackDays = 7d;
let WindowSec = 86400;
let RMM = SecurityEvent
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where EventID == 4688
    | where (NewProcessName endswith @"\msiexec.exe"
             and CommandLine has_any ("AteraAgent","Splashtop","AnyDesk","ScreenConnect","ConnectWiseControl")
             and CommandLine has_any ("/quiet","/qn"))
          or NewProcessName has_any ("\\AteraAgent.exe","\\SplashtopStreamer.exe","\\AnyDesk.exe","\\ConnectWiseControl.ClientService.exe")
    | where SubjectUserName !endswith "$"
    | where ParentProcessName !endswith @"\ccmexec.exe"
         and ParentProcessName !endswith @"\IntuneManagementExtension.exe"
    | project RMMTime = TimeGenerated, Computer, RMMUser = SubjectUserName,
              RMMCmd = CommandLine, RMMBin = NewProcessName, RMMParent = ParentProcessName;
let Impact = SecurityEvent
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where EventID == 4688
    | where (NewProcessName endswith @"\vssadmin.exe" and CommandLine has_any ("delete shadows","resize shadowstorage"))
         or (NewProcessName endswith @"\wmic.exe" and CommandLine has "shadowcopy" and CommandLine has "delete")
         or (NewProcessName endswith @"\bcdedit.exe" and CommandLine has_any ("recoveryenabled No","bootstatuspolicy ignoreallfailures"))
         or (NewProcessName endswith @"\wbadmin.exe" and CommandLine has "delete")
    | project ImpactTime = TimeGenerated, Computer, ImpactCmd = CommandLine, ImpactBin = NewProcessName;
RMM
| join kind=inner Impact on Computer
| where ImpactTime between (RMMTime .. RMMTime + WindowSec * 1s)
| project RMMTime, ImpactTime,
          DelayHours = datetime_diff('hour', ImpactTime, RMMTime),
          Computer, RMMUser, RMMParent, RMMBin, RMMCmd, ImpactBin, ImpactCmd
| summarize arg_min(RMMTime, *) by Computer
| order by ImpactTime desc
ucs.datadog_query: source:(windows.sysmon OR windows.security) @EventID:(1 OR 4688) ((@Image:(*\msiexec.exe OR *\MsiExec.exe) AND @CommandLine:(*AteraAgent* OR *Splashtop* OR *AnyDesk* OR *ScreenConnect* OR *ConnectWiseControl*) AND @CommandLine:(*\/quiet* OR *\/qn*)) OR @Image:(*\AteraAgent.exe OR *\SplashtopStreamer.exe OR *\AnyDesk.exe OR *\ConnectWiseControl.ClientService.exe)) -@User:*$ -@ParentImage:(*\ccmexec.exe OR *\IntuneManagementExtension.exe)
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2
| (ImageFileName=/\\msiexec\.exe$/i AND CommandLine=/(AteraAgent|Splashtop|AnyDesk|ScreenConnect|ConnectWiseControl)/i AND CommandLine=/\/(quiet|qn)\b/i)
  OR ImageFileName=/\\(AteraAgent|SplashtopStreamer|AnyDesk|ConnectWiseControl\.ClientService)\.exe$/i
| NOT UserName=/\$$/
| NOT ParentBaseFileName=/(ccmexec|intunemanagementextension|chocolatey|choco)\.exe$/i
| join({
    #event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2
    | (ImageFileName=/\\vssadmin\.exe$/i AND CommandLine=/delete\s+shadows|resize\s+shadowstorage/i)
      OR (ImageFileName=/\\wmic\.exe$/i AND CommandLine=/shadowcopy.*delete/i)
      OR (ImageFileName=/\\bcdedit\.exe$/i AND CommandLine=/(recoveryenabled\s+No|bootstatuspolicy\s+ignoreallfailures)/i)
      OR (ImageFileName=/\\wbadmin\.exe$/i AND CommandLine=/delete/i)
  }, field=aid, include=[ImageFileName, CommandLine])
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName], function=count())
| sort(field=_count, order=desc)
ucs.rationale: Sophos, Symantec and Mandiant incident reports converge on this exact RansomHub staging sequence: an affiliate deploys 1-2 RMM tools (Atera + Splashtop is the canonical pair, AnyDesk runner-up) hours before pulling the trigger on vssadmin/bcdedit recovery destruction. The 24-hour temporal join collapses the false-positive base rate: legitimate Atera deployment via Intune/SCCM does NOT chain to vss
